$comment: The request body limit of the local API (POST /api/v1/inspect/tool among its routes) and the fields of an OpenClaw message call that carry an attachment. One source: the gateway reads body_max_bytes (internal/gateway apiRequestBodyMaxBytes) and message_attachment_keys (messageAttachmentField) from this embedded file, and the plugin build copies it next to its sources (make plugin). The plugin sends a message call whole up to body_max_bytes. Over it, only a base64 value under a message_attachment_keys field becomes a descriptor (its size, type, hash and the text in it); message text is never cut, and a call that still does not fit is blocked in every pack (rel-1-0-10:GAP-0356, GAP-0402, GAP-0436).
